title: Agricultural Chemicals & Fertilizers
description: Fertilizers, soil conditioners, crop protection chemicals, and irrigation water treatment products for Oman's farming and greenhouse sectors.

details.longDescription: Agricultural Chemicals and Fertilizers supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies specialty agrochemicals, fertilizers, and crop protection chemicals to farms, greenhouses, and agricultural operations across Oman. Under Vision 2040, Oman has significantly increased investment in domestic food production, expanding cultivated areas in Al Batinah, Al Dakhiliyah, Al Sharqiyah, and Dhofar regions. Global Chemicals LLC supports this agricultural expansion by supplying the critical inputs farmers need. Our agricultural chemical range includes straight and compound fertilizers (urea 46% N, diammonium phosphate — DAP, potassium chloride/sulphate, NPK compound fertilizers, calcium nitrate), micronutrient fertilizers (zinc sulphate, manganese sulphate, boron, iron chelates, copper sulphate — for micronutrient correction in Oman's soils), soil conditioners (gypsum, lime, humic acid, sulphur), irrigation water treatment chemicals (acid for drip irrigation pH correction, antiscalants for emitter protection, algaecides for open channel irrigation), and crop protection products. We supply to farms in Nizwa, Barka, Sohar, Al Batinah coast, and greenhouses across the interior. Delivery to all Oman agricultural regions. Technical advice on fertilizer programmes and soil chemistry available from our team.

faqs.question: What agricultural chemicals does Global Chemicals LLC supply in Oman?
faqs.answer: Global Chemicals LLC supplies a range of agricultural input chemicals to Oman's farming, horticulture, and landscaping sector. Products include soil amendments (calcium carbonate agricultural lime for pH adjustment, dolomite lime, gypsum for sodic soil improvement), fertiliser-grade chemicals (urea, potassium chloride, ammonium nitrate, mono-ammonium phosphate), water treatment chemicals for drip irrigation systems (citric acid for pH reduction, preventing calcium carbonate scale in emitters; chlorine for irrigation water disinfection), and specialty chemicals for date palm, vegetable, and fruit cultivation across Oman's interior regions. In Oman's arid agricultural regions including Batinah Coast, Dakhliyah, and Al Wusta, water quality management and soil amendment are critical for sustainable crop production. We also supply formaldehyde and disinfectants for greenhouse sterilisation, surfactants for pesticide adjuvant formulations, and micronutrient salts. All agricultural chemicals are supplied with crop-safe documentation and applicable Oman Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries Wealth import approvals.

faqs.question: How is urea used in Omani agriculture and what is the correct application rate?
faqs.answer: Urea (CO(NH₂)₂, 46-0-0) is the most concentrated solid nitrogen fertiliser available (46% nitrogen by weight) and the most widely used nitrogen source in Oman's agriculture, including date palm plantations, vegetable cultivation, and cereal crops. In Oman, urea is applied by three methods: broadcast application (spread uniformly across soil surface and incorporated by irrigation, typical rate 150–300 kg/ha per crop season for date palms), fertigation through drip irrigation (urea dissolved in irrigation water and delivered directly to the root zone at controlled rates — more efficient and reduces nitrogen volatilisation losses), and foliar spray (dilute urea solution 0.5–1.0% applied to leaf surface for rapid nitrogen uptake when roots are under stress). In Oman's alkaline calcareous soils (pH 7.5–8.5), urea hydrolysis to ammonia and subsequent volatilisation can cause nitrogen losses of 20–40% if not incorporated promptly. Urease inhibitors or immediate irrigation after application minimises losses. Global Chemicals LLC supplies food/feed-grade and agricultural-grade urea with Oman Ministry of Agriculture import documentation.
